gaps.sentence: She was wearing ___ old denim jacket that I loved at first sight.
gaps.explanation: 'An old…' — 'old' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: ___ spaceship travelled for six months before reaching Mars.
gaps.explanation: The spaceship — the one in the story; Mars takes no article.

gaps.sentence: My sister studies at ___ university in Berlin.
gaps.explanation: 'University' starts with a /juː/ consonant sound, so 'a'.

gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.

gaps.explanation: Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).

gaps.sentence: She was elected ___ president of the students' union.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint/make + role', the article is usually dropped: elected president.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
